items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: Lash had seven men built the church. My father picked it.

ctx.x: Your father had the church there all that time?

The church is still there, but there was a tear down there about a month ago. I don't know. The church is still there. The church that he was paying for. The church that he bought out of debt that a preacher had had. You understand? Yeah. And couldn't pay it out. You know, they built it. Lash had seven men built the church. My father picked it. Taking that church. Was ordained minister. He got ordained. And he taken that church over and brought out of debt. And preached and passed through the church until he…
Speaking of funerals and parades, did you ever play any brass band?
